All operations are confined to the package's intended functionality: detecting installed applications and applying local icon theme patches. The script does not tamper with system files outside its scope, nor does it introduce backdoors or execute untrusted payloads. While it dynamically determines which packages to process, this behavior is consistent with the tool's purpose and does not represent a supply-chain risk.
